title: ServiceOrderRequest
description: Request payload for creating a service order

assigned_user_id.description: The user assigned to work on the service order

customer_id.description: The customer associated with the service

extra_fields.description: Deprecated. Additional custom fields for the service order

location.description: Deprecated: Use top-level location field instead. Location where the service will be performed

note.description: Deprecated: Use top-level Notes field instead. Additional note for the service order

item_id.description: ID of an already existing item

job_status_id.description: The ID of a custom service status to assign to this order. When provided, overrides the `status` field.

location.description: Location where the service will be performed

notes.description: Notes associated with the service order

created_at.description: The date and time when the note was created (possible to pre-date the note)

is_visible_to_customer.description: Whether the note is visible to customer (printed on the service receipt or not)

outlet_id.description: The outlet of the service order

register_id.description: The register of the service order

status.description: The status of the service order
